h1: Breckenridge ski resort, stays & events guide
heroText: Breckenridge is a Victorian mining town with 2,908 acres above it, and a third of that terrain is graded expert - a share no other resort in this batch publishes. The summit on Peak 8 reaches 12,998 feet, and the 4 O'Clock Run ends on Main Street.
stayOverview: Main Street is the reason to stay in Breckenridge rather than at a base: the 4 O'Clock Run brings you back to it, and the restaurants are there. Peak 8 and Peak 9 are the ski-in alternatives.
hotelIntro: Book against high season. Peak 9 is the base closest to Main Street; Peak 8 is closest to the terrain parks and the highest lifts.
rentalCars: Breckenridge is about 100 miles west of Denver on Interstate 70 and Highway 9, and the town has a free bus.
